Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports severe headaches affecting work.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experiences intermittent frontal headaches at work, in meetings, and at the computer.
Headache onset occurred after a job change.
Headaches are often associated with mild nausea.
Headaches are not preceded by aura.
This is the first time the patient has had these headache symptoms.
Patient reports episodic palpitations described as heart 'beating kinda fast' about once per day or more.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Episodic palpitations (heart "beating kinda fast") ~once/day or more

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations sometimes occur when entering an elevator.
Palpitations are associated with occasional shortness of breath at rest while sitting at the desk.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: associated occasional SOB at rest (at desk)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Shortness of breath is not associated with exertion.
Patient reports intermittent bilateral arm and hand tingling (paresthesias).
There is no leg involvement with the paresthesias.
Patient has had an unintentional weight loss of about 5 pounds since the job change.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: unintentional ~5 lb weight loss since job change

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Clothes are not noticeably looser despite weight loss.

Patient rates work-related stress as 7–8 out of 10.

No vitals or physical exam findings are documented because the patient is to be seen in clinic.
